title: Devman OpenCart Google Marketing Tools Extension product_id_key Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Devman OpenCart Google Marketing Tools. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of the product_id_key parameter. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
